_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'Transition to Operations Checklist' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-07.04.

f01_Handover_Item.label: Handover Item
f01_Handover_Item.guidance: The operational deliverable, documentation, system asset, credentials, warranty, or support agreement formally transferred to the sustaining operations team.

f02_Responsible_Party.label: Responsible Party
f02_Responsible_Party.guidance: The operational team, service owner, or designated role accepting ongoing responsibility and stewardship for the item.

f03_Acceptance_Criteria.label: Acceptance Criteria
f03_Acceptance_Criteria.guidance: The specific operational readiness criteria and verification evidence required before formal handover sign-off.

f04_Handover_Date.label: Handover Date
f04_Handover_Date.guidance: The scheduled or actual date on which ownership and support accountability are formally transferred.

f05_Sign_off_Status.label: Sign-off Status
f05_Sign_off_Status.guidance: The formal verification status (e.g., Accepted, Conditional, Pending) confirming operational readiness.
